name: sg-llm-chat-history
description: Multi-turn conversation display and state manager. Owns the turn array, renders user/assistant bubbles, handles live streaming, assembles the messages array, and emits SEND on each user message. Collapsible system prompt editor.
notes: Uses Shadow DOM. Listens for llm:chat-message (from sg-llm-chat-input). Multimodal: image attachments become content arrays, text files appended to message text. Export to markdown via exportMarkdown().
